# Medium Compression Editor Skill

## Purpose

Make the article shorter, clearer, and more readable without losing meaning.

## Process

For each section, ask:

> What is the single job of this section?

Cut anything that does not support that job.

## Remove phrases like

```text
It is important to note that...
In today's fast-paced world...
This article will explore...
Let's dive into...
There are several reasons why...
This is a game changer...
```

## Actions

- Merge repeated ideas.
- Convert lists into prose where natural.
- Replace abstract phrasing with concrete examples.
- Shorten long sentences.
- Remove filler.
- Keep explanations complete.

## Target

Reduce draft length by 10–20% after the substance draft.
